title: Docgen Client Configuration
description: Configuration for a client's WordPress site documentation generation

client_code.description: Lowercase client code (e.g., mm, clientc, clienta)

site_url.description: Client site base URL (no trailing slash)

notion_portal_root_id.description: Notion page ID of the duplicated client portal root

wp_login.description: Notion page ID for How to Log into WordPress

edit_text.description: Notion page ID for How to Edit Text on a Page (Gutenberg)

edit_text_lc.description: Notion page ID for How to Edit Text on a Page (LiveCanvas)

change_image.description: Notion page ID for How to Change a Page Image (Gutenberg)

change_image_lc.description: Notion page ID for How to Change a Page Image (LiveCanvas)

publish_blog.description: Notion page ID for How to Publish a Blog Post

featured_image.description: Notion page ID for How to Set a Featured Image

update_seo.description: Notion page ID for How to Update SEO

notion_guide_pages.description: Map of guide slugs to Notion page IDs. LC variants are optional — only present for LiveCanvas sites.

page_editor.description: Page editor used for content pages (not blog posts). Detected during setup.

seo_plugin.description: Detected SEO plugin, or none/null if not yet detected

created_at.description: ISO timestamp of when this config was created

last_capture.description: ISO timestamp of last screenshot capture run

last_notion_update.description: ISO timestamp of last Notion guide update
